_comment: Recipe that produced the released rib_unet_3d.pth (= full_run_v1/models/unet_ep20.pth). The original run read Centerlines_GT_corrected, which is byte-identical to Centerlines_GT for all 48 training subjects (verified in experiments/rebuttal/provenance.json); augmentation was NOT applied (the flag was ignored by the old script) and samples_per_volume was hard-coded to 8.
